name: ICOR for Life - Interface
description: The vault's chrome in one place: the INKLINE Look (flat or gradient), where properties show (on top, folded or under the note), _System in the file tree, the ribbon and the app's own controls as switches, a collapsible status bar, Outline depth, a fullscreen viewer for mermaid diagrams, the ICOR stage colours on the folders (from the vault's schema), and any folder's own colour, icon and label. The INKLINE theme draws the chrome. Part of the ICOR for Life suite.
author: myICOR
